reviewed_by: Codex review of v3.0.10 MCP failure and PR #750 main merge
reason: The affected real Core, production-bundle, non-loopback LAN MCP import journey at 430 px WebKit reproduced the release failure: the Edit icon began outside the viewport, Playwright completed its click, and no dialog appeared. CI then showed the same sticky Settings tab intercepting the empty-state Import action at 320 px WebKit. The focused test centers Settings actions, checks that each button owns its hit point, uses touch input on phones, and requires import and edit dialogs to appear before proceeding through trust, probe, enable, refresh, and update. Desktop, 320 px Chromium, 320 px WebKit, and 430 px WebKit cover mouse and phone touch behavior.
exclusions: This test-only change excludes other device profiles, backend and frontend unit files, native tests, unrelated journeys, and the full suite. The product MCP flow is unchanged; release package and other real-Core gates remain separate.
